findings.evidence: E8/Basic.lean:287 `@[simp] theorem e8Root_simple (i : Fin 8) : e8Root (Fin.castAdd 232 i) = CartanMatrix.E₈.row i`; E8/Basic.lean:292 `@[simp] theorem e8Coroot_simple (i : Fin 8) : e8Coroot (Fin.castAdd 232 i) = Pi.single i 1`; Datum.lean:136 `def e8SimpleIndex (i : Fin 8) : Fin 240 := Fin.castAdd 232 i`; Datum.lean:150 `coroot_e8SimpleIndex ... := e8Coroot_simple i`; Datum.lean:146 `(e8Root_simple i).trans (Matrix.row_apply' _ i)`; mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Defs.lean:628 `lemma row_apply'` carries no `@[simp]`.
findings.fix: Move `e8SimpleIndex`, `e8SimpleIndex_val` and `e8SimpleIndex_injective` into `E8/Basic.lean` (which this PR already touches), restate the two table lemmas there as `root_e8SimpleIndex : e8Root (e8SimpleIndex i) = CartanMatrix.E₈ i` and `coroot_e8SimpleIndex : e8Coroot (e8SimpleIndex i) = Pi.single i 1`, delete `e8Root_simple`/`e8Coroot_simple` and the two copies in `Datum.lean`, and update the docstring reference.
findings.issue: `root_e8SimpleIndex` and `coroot_e8SimpleIndex` duplicate the pre-existing public `@[simp]` lemmas `e8Root_simple` and `e8Coroot_simple` in `E8/Basic.lean`: `e8SimpleIndex i` is by definition `Fin.castAdd 232 i`, so `coroot_e8SimpleIndex` is literally `e8Coroot_simple i`. The post-PR surface carries two public simp names for each fact, and for the root they disagree on the right-hand side (`CartanMatrix.E₈ i` here, `CartanMatrix.E₈.row i` there), so `e8Root (e8SimpleIndex i)` and `e8Root (Fin.castAdd 232 i)` normalise differently — `Matrix.row_apply'` is not a simp lemma. The datum's own docstring at line 97 points at `e8Root_simple`, not at the lemma the file defines.

findings.evidence: E8Coordinates.lean:66-71 state both in emod form; E8/Lattice.lean:220-221 and 226-227 both read `Dvd.dvd.mul_left (Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero (e8DoubledSimpleRoot_sub_emod i j)) _` / `(... e8DoubledSimpleRoot_sum_emod i) _`; E8/Lattice.lean:75-76 defines `IsDoubledE8` with `(2 : ℤ) ∣ x j - x 0` and `(4 : ℤ) ∣ ∑ j, x j`.
findings.fix: Keep the `decide`-provable `% = 0` statements as `private` and export `e8DoubledSimpleRoot_two_dvd_sub : ∀ i j, (2 : ℤ) ∣ e8DoubledSimpleRoot i j - e8DoubledSimpleRoot i 0` and `e8DoubledSimpleRoot_four_dvd_sum : ∀ i, (4 : ℤ) ∣ ∑ j, e8DoubledSimpleRoot i j`, each `fun .. => Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero (by decide)`.
findings.issue: `e8DoubledSimpleRoot_sub_emod` and `e8DoubledSimpleRoot_sum_emod` are the public characteristic lemmas of a new shared module, but they state `_ % 2 = 0` and `_ % 4 = 0` rather than the divisibility they actually express; both call sites wrap them in `Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero`, and the predicate they feed (`IsDoubledE8`) is itself phrased with `∣`.

summary: The datum's surface is otherwise minimal and well-characterized, but the PR adds a second public @[simp] name for each of the two simple-root/simple-coroot facts already public on main, and one of the pair even fixes a different right-hand-side normal form. The new shared E8Coordinates module also exports its two lattice congruences in `% = 0` form that every consumer immediately converts.
